title: Shopify All-in-One Scraper Input
description: Extract products, collections, reviews, and merchant contact info from any Shopify store. Just enter a store domain — no API keys or login required.

storeUrls.title: Shopify Store URLs / Domains
storeUrls.description: Use this field when the user provides a Shopify store URL or domain name. Accepts full URLs (https://gymshark.com) or bare domains (gymshark.com). Add multiple stores for batch scraping. Use this for specific known stores. Do NOT use this for keyword-based discovery — this actor scrapes stores you already know.
storeUrls.sectionDescription: Which Shopify stores to scrape. Enter one store domain per line.

scrapeProducts.title: Scrape Products
scrapeProducts.description: Use this when the user wants product data: titles, prices, discounts, variants, stock status, images, SKUs, or barcodes. Enables product extraction from /products.json. Charged at $0.003 per product.
scrapeProducts.sectionDescription: Choose what data to scrape. Each type is charged separately — only pay for what you use.

scrapeCollections.title: Scrape Collections
scrapeCollections.description: Use this when the user wants product categories, collections, or store taxonomy. Extracts all collection handles, titles, descriptions, and product counts from /collections.json. Charged at $0.001 per collection.

scrapeReviews.title: Scrape Customer Reviews
scrapeReviews.description: Use this when the user wants customer reviews, star ratings, verified buyer status, or review text. Auto-detects review platform (Judge.me, Yotpo). Each review is charged separately at $0.001. Use maxReviewsPerProduct to control volume.

scrapeContactInfo.title: Scrape Merchant Contact Info
scrapeContactInfo.description: Use this when the user wants merchant emails, phone numbers, or social media links for B2B outreach, lead generation, or sales prospecting. Extracts live contact data from the store's pages. Charged at $0.005 per store (one record per store). This gives the highest ROI for sales teams.

maxProductsPerStore.title: Max Products per Store
maxProductsPerStore.description: Maximum number of products to extract from each store. Default 50 for quick tests; use higher values for full catalog extraction.

maxCollectionsPerStore.title: Max Collections per Store
maxCollectionsPerStore.description: Maximum number of collections to extract from each store when scrapeCollections is enabled. Default 250 for most stores; large fashion/home stores may have thousands.

maxReviewsPerProduct.title: Max Reviews per Product
maxReviewsPerProduct.description: Maximum reviews to fetch per product when scrapeReviews is enabled. Applies per product, not total. Start with 50 for a sample; use higher values for full sentiment analysis.
